budget_items.topic: October financial report: reserves, shelter rents, net metering
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Reserves were reported at 68.21%, up from 42% in January and 60% in June; shelter rents were budgeted at $209,000 against actual of $206,000; net metering credits were $15,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sheila Lancelotta reviewed three DHCD funding areas (a 10% ANUEL increase, a one-time $5,000 technical award, and a $200 per unit health and safety exemption totaling $10,800) and presented a balanced budget.
